data.body:
Calibration complete; full reviewer evidence, per-ticket labels, source links, detector implementation, and recommendations are in session_log 59a7-cb88-f2f9-4148.

Three blind background-agent batches reviewed 24 assignments / 20 unique tickets (two shared): 10 near-limit, 10 over-limit; five each bug/epic/story/task. Adjudicated overall: 6 bloated, 14 appropriate. Shared agreement: cibophobic-moist-guineafowl unanimous appropriate/all rules absent; uncheered-sombre-bumblebee split 1 bloated vs 2 appropriate, with R2/R9 the only per-rule disagreements. Final label: appropriate, medium confidence; dissent retained.

Confusion categories below are count (% of applicable N), with NA excluded:

| Rule | N/NA | TP | FP | FN | TN |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| R1 exact duplication | 20/0 | 1 (5.0%) | 1 (5.0%) | 1 (5.0%) | 17 (85.0%) |
| R2 near/history duplication | 20/0 | 0 | 0 | 4 (20.0%) | 16 (80.0%) |
| R3 transcript dump | 20/0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 20 (100%) |
| R4 empty update | 17/3 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 17 (100%) |
| R5 filler/meta | 20/0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 20 (100%) |
| R6 sentence/paragraph sprawl | 20/0 | 6 (30.0%) | 14 (70.0%) | 0 | 0 |
| R7 alternatives/hedges | 20/0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 20 (100%) |
| R8 imperative saturation | 20/0 | 0 | 0 | 2 (10.0%) | 18 (90.0%) |
| R9 length envelope | 20/0 | 5 (25.0%) | 13 (65.0%) | 0 | 2 (10.0%) |
| R10 canonical copying | 19/1 | 0 | 0 | 2 (10.5%) | 17 (89.5%) |

Union versus overall bloat: TP 6 (30%), FP 14 (70%), FN 0, TN 0; precision 30%, recall 100%, specificity 0%. R6 fired on all 20, so naive OR is unusable. R9 recall was 100% but precision 27.8%; length must remain a review request, not a bloat verdict. R2/R8/R10 require recall work. R3/R4/R5/R7 had no positive controls, so sensitivity remains unknown.

Recommended enforcement: block only objective high-threshold R1 duplication, unsummarized high-volume R3 transcript dumps, and R4 empty updates; keep all other rules advisory with matched spans, protected-fact safeguards, reasoned suppression, and no automatic deletion. Use R6 only for span-level coaching, R9 only with another independent redundancy signal, revision-aware/linked-ticket comparison for R10, and never combine all findings with OR.

Limitations: long-ticket enrichment, 20 unique records, only two triply reviewed records, single reviewer for 18, local current-revision source comparison, and no positives for four rules. Next step is an ordinary-length + positive-control development set followed by a frozen held-out validation set.
